base.description:
{Terror Eye}

One glare of pure dread, and the stricken creature no longer remembers how to fight back.

none.description:
{Terror Eye}

One glare of pure dread, and the stricken creature no longer remembers how to fight back.

basic.description:
{Basic Terror Eye}

The Shadowmare's dreadful gaze leaves its victim too shaken to strike back. Only the fearless feel nothing.

advanced.description:
{Advanced Terror Eye}

Half of the mare's stares hit home, leaving the victim too terrified to retaliate for several turns. Please do not make eye contact.

expert.description:
{Expert Terror Eye}

The stare reaches across the whole battlefield, gripping the victim with terror until it forgets how to retaliate. Undead, machines and the mindless meet it with empty eyes.
